# T3 Math: T3 Code with LaTeX rendering

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This is an unofficial fork of [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code) that renders LaTeX math in chat.**
>
> **It is updated from upstream every week.** Each Monday it merges the latest T3 Code, rebuilds, and publishes desktop apps for macOS, Linux and Windows. Installed apps update themselves.
>
> **[Download the latest build](https://github.com/DhrumanGupta/t3-math/releases/latest)** · **[Running instructions](RUNNING_INSTRUCTIONS.md)** · [What differs from upstream](FORK.md) · [Report a problem](https://github.com/DhrumanGupta/t3-math/issues)
>
> The apps are not signed with a paid certificate, so macOS and Windows block them on first launch. **[Follow the running instructions](RUNNING_INSTRUCTIONS.md)** to open them.
>
> T3 Math is not affiliated with or supported by the T3 Code team. Everything below this notice is upstream's README, unchanged.
